courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: So our application is taking shape here,
now one thing that of course is not working as it should is if we reload on that discover page, we're
not fetching any places because right now, we're only using our fetchPlaces method here which we added
in the places service on the offer page,
of course we should use that on other pages too, basically on all the pages where we need all places and
that of course would be our discover page as well.
So let's go to the discover page and there
we already injected the places service, we set up the subscription here in ngOnInit which of course
is fine but just as before I want to add ionViewWillEnter here to also use the places service here
to call fetchPlaces and then subscribe to that and just as before, we can then use an isLoading property
here, isLoading false to show a spinner.
So in ionViewWillEnter, I'll set isLoading to true
and then here in this function I pass to subscribe, I set isLoading back to false and as a side note,
of course you can refine the application to check whether you already have data loaded and in that case
you might not want to show a spinner and fetch new data invisibly in the background and only show
the spinner if you have no data yet, that is all possible. Here
I will use a simpler approach,
I will simply add or set this property whenever we start fetching data and we do start fetching
data whenever this view is about to become visible and in the template of the discover page,
I therefore can use isLoading to show a spinner.
So my idea here is to always show these segments here,
let's say but then here in the grid where I show there are no bookable places right now,
that is nice
but first of all, I also want to check if isLoading is not true,
so if not isLoading and then that condition here should be met
so I'll wrap this in brackets.
So if we're not loading and we have no places, then I want to show this message or if we're not loading
and this condition here is met, then I want to show the places, otherwise I'll add a new grid here let's say
and there, I will use the same size classes as before and also centering, here I will show my ion-spinner
with a color of primary and this entire grid up here will only be shown if isLoading is true and
of course it's up to you if you use ngIf on the grid, on a row, on a column, whatever basically suits
the rest of the structure you have in place.
So with that changed, if this reloads,
we now see the spinner and we're good
and now of course when I go to offer and I go back, I see that spinner here again and that is what
I meant. You could of course change the code such that you only showed the spinner if no data has been
loaded before, whatever suits your needs and however you want to have this in your application.
